movelist.name: Fake Out
movelist.effect: You may only use Fake Out with Priority upon joining an encounter; if you do, Fake Out Flinches the target. Switching out resets the requirement of joining an encounter.

movelist.name: Fake Tears
movelist.effect: Lower the target’s Special Defense 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Assurance
movelist.effect: When you hit with Assurance, if Assurance’s target has already been damaged by a Move on the same round Assurance is being used, Assurance has a Damage Base of 12 (3d12+10 / 30) instead. This effect may trigger only once per Scene per Target.

movelist.name: Flatter
movelist.effect: The target’s Special Attack is raised by +1 Combat Stage. Flatter Confuses the target.

movelist.name: Swagger
movelist.effect: The target’s Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages. Swagger Confuses the target.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.effect: The user gains a +2 Bonus to all Accuracy Rolls against adjacent targets.

abilities.name: Weird Power
abilities.effect: If the user’s Attack is higher than its Special Attack, the user may add its Attack Stat to its Special Damage Rolls. If their Special Attack is higher, they user may add its Special Attack Stat to its Physical Damage Rolls. This does not stack with Mixed Power.
